summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin implements the staff admin welcome page for a web application, providing filtering and viewing of student employment applications. The page includes controls for site, discipline, date range, and status filtering, and displays application data in a grid. The code manages dropdown population, validation, event handling, and supports AJAX updates. It features error/warning panels, validation summary, calendar controls, and paging for the applications grid.
purpose: To allow staff administrators to view and filter student employment applications by site, discipline, date range, and withdrawn status. It provides a dashboard-like interface with real-time updates and validation, supporting efficient review and management of submitted and withdrawn applications.

workflows.name: Page Initialization
steps: SetupHSPnetPage to initialize page with session and footer.
Register JavaScript files: WelcomeStaffAdmin.js, Date.js.
Display welcome title and last login info.
Populate dropdowns for sites and discipline based on agency and optional query parameter.
Set default date range (last 3 months to today).
Bind application data to grid view.
Set default button for form submission.

workflows.name: Filtering and Refresh
steps: Staff selects site, discipline, date range, and withdrawn status.
Dropdown changes trigger RefreshData method.
cmdRefreshView button click triggers RefreshData.
RefreshData binds gvwApplications to dsEmploymentApplications datasource.
Datasource selection uses session values, dropdown selections, and dates as input parameters.

workflows.name: Validation
steps: RequiredFieldValidators and RegularExpressionValidators validate start and end dates.
CustomValidator ensures start date is not after end date (client function checkStartEnd).
ValidationSummary displays errors.

workflows.name: Grid Display
steps: Applications grid shows name, email, site, submitted date, status.
RowDataBound event creates links and status labels.
Withdrawn applications marked, withdrawn date displayed if applicable.
Paging enabled, up to 50 results per page.

workflows.name: Error/Warning Handling
steps: Panels for error and warning messages.
Hide error/warning panel via button.

business_rules: Only applications within selected date range are shown.
Withdrawn applications can be included or excluded with checkbox.
Dropdown selections default to 'All' when loaded.
validations: Start and end date are required.
Date format must match Date_ValidationExpression pattern.
End date must not precede start date (checkStartEnd function).
calculations: Date range default: last 3 months (Today.AddMonths(-3) to Today).
conditions: Populate dropdowns depending on presence of SiteID query parameter.
Show panels only if error/warning messages exist.
Withdrawn status and date based on presence of WithdrawnDate.
system_behavior: AJAX panels for main content and error/warning messages.
Client-side JavaScript variables setup for date fields.
Grid supports paging, filtering, and real-time updates.
Handles post-back and async post-back scenarios.
exceptions: Missing session or site ID defaults to standard dropdown population.
content_gaps: No explicit permission checks or security settings documented.
No details on exception/error handling for failed database calls.
No information on user roles beyond 'Staff Administrator'.
